title: Fit a conversation into the context window
hints: trim_history: first set aside the system messages and subtract their cost from the limit. That is your budget.
Walk the other messages from the end: for index in range(len(messages) - 1, -1, -1). Stop with break at the first that costs more than the budget.
Remember the indexes you keep, and build the result with a list comprehension over the original list, so the order is preserved.
